purpose: Teach: 子連れ/いかんせん/寒気/絶句/思いこん/ほど遠い/年老い/顔立ち

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前ん家、子連れの親戚が来てたな
lines.en: Riku, your cousin's family came over the other day, didn't they?
lines.style: Light tease in a half-whisper. Quick, knowing. Testing whether he'll admit to something. The rhythm of someone who knows how to needle a friend.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、いかんせん勉強サボってるな、桜
lines.en: You're one to talk — you've been skipping studying pretty hard, haven't you?
lines.style: Dry deflection with a slight edge. Fast comeback, no real heat. The tone of someone flipping the accusation back before it lands.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、寒気で熱出したな
lines.en: Riku, you got sick from the cold the other day though.
lines.style: Observation delivered softly, almost to herself. Not quite gentle, not quite accusatory. Noticing something he might not want noticed.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、テスト結果見て絶句してたな、桜
lines.en: And you looked completely shocked when you saw your test results, remember?
lines.style: Pointed but steady. Each clause lands separately. A small smile in the voice — not cruel, but not letting him off the hook either.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、答え覚えてると思いこんでただろ
lines.en: You walked in thinking you'd remembered all the answers.
lines.style: Quiet incredulous tone. Slow on the first clause, then picks up slightly. The unspoken 'but you didn't' hanging at the end.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、合格にはほど遠い点数だったな、桜
lines.en: Your score was nowhere near passing, and you know it.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact, delivered with the gentleness of someone who isn't trying to wound. Steady eye contact. The tone of a friend naming something true.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、先生も年老いてこられたな
lines.en: Your teacher's getting older though, isn't she?
lines.style: Quick pivot away. Lighter, almost dismissive. Looking for a subject change — something to acknowledge without staying with it.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、整った顔立ちだな、桜
lines.en: You've got a nice face, though, Sakura. That counts for something.
lines.style: Soft and genuine underneath the casual words. Steady, not rushed. The kind of thing he probably didn't plan to say. A little vulnerable under the surface.
